name: pr-pipeline
description: Takes a ticket (Jira, GitHub issue, Linear, or the task in words) through nine recorded stages to a merge-ready PR, routes each stage to a model by task class, reviews with Claude, Codex, OpenCode or any other agent CLI, and shows checks, review threads and merge inside a pane so nothing needs opening on GitHub.

reviewer.title: Review backend
reviewer.description: Which harness runs the AI review stage

review_model.title: Review model
review_model.description: Model for the AI review when the routing table does not pick one (claude: opus, sonnet, haiku; codex: gpt-5-codex, gpt-5, o3; opencode: provider/model; custom: whatever the command takes)

review_command.title: Review command
review_command.description: Shell command for the custom reviewer; it gets the review prompt on stdin and must print the review JSON on stdout; {model} is replaced with review_model

review_effort.title: Review effort
review_effort.description: Reasoning effort for the AI review
